experiments.scope: The advice pair of the package (Dariia's HEAD30 witness: chaining value CV*, blocks M1, M1') and a seeded random first block M0 per trial (proof Sections 2 and 5). Per trial: the message-schedule difference support of (M1, M1') over 41 words, the rows with zero state difference when both members run from CV*, the same count from the trial's own chaining value (control: no transplant is applied by this program), and the candidate two-block messages M0 || M1 and M0 || M1'. The claw walk and the tail sampler (tools in the research package) are not run here.
experiments.hypothesis: The advice pair's schedule difference is supported on words 8..12 with expansions at 16, 17, 24, 26, 31, 33, 35, 37, 38, 39, 40 (the characteristic, proof Section 1); from CV* the state difference is zero on rows 27..30 (the local collision closes, proof Section 2); from a random chaining value without the transplant it is not; no full collision is expected at organizer scale.
